# Arra

> Merchant game-day promises ("if our team wins, it's on us") backed by USDC locked on Arc, priced from Gemini Prediction Markets, verifiable by anyone. Testnet prototype; no real money.

## How it works
- A merchant picks a long shot on a Gemini sports market and a payout.
- The pricer walks Gemini's order book and signs a 60-second EIP-712 quote.
- The merchant calls buyCover on the ArraVault contract on Arc; the payout is locked in USDC.
- Mutually exclusive outcomes net: the vault locks the largest payout per event, not the sum.
- Settlers vote Gemini's result (2-of-3, unanimous settles instantly); winners are paid from the vault.

## Contract
- Network: Arc Testnet, chain ID 5042002, RPC https://rpc.testnet.arc.network
- ArraVault: see https://github.com/Qiao527/arra-protocol/blob/main/deployments/arc-testnet.json
- Explorer: https://explorer.testnet.arc.io

## Pricer API
- GET /health
- GET /events: coverable Gemini markets (game winners, period winners, championships) with outcomes in canonical order
- POST /quote {eventTicker, instrumentSymbol, side, payoutUsdc, buyer}: signed quote plus price breakdown
- Base URL: https://arra-pricer.onrender.com

## Pages
- Make a promise: /#/
- Proof of a promise: /#/p/{policyId}?t={geminiEventTicker}
- Risk desk: /#/desk
